items.basis: EU-Türkiye Customs Union (Association Council Decision No 1/95, in force 31 Dec 1995) removed tariffs on ALL industrial goods (aluminium, polymers included); coal, iron and steel products are covered separately by the 1996 ECSC-Türkiye free trade agreement, which the EU took over after the ECSC Treaty expired — EU steel enters duty-free. Turkish trade defence in force: anti-dumping duties of 6.10%-43.31% of CIF on hot-rolled flat steel (HS 7208/7211/7212/7225) from China (15-43%), India, Japan and Russia (6-9%) — Official Gazette 11 Oct 2024 — NOT on EU origin.
items.kind: statute / official trade-agreement summary (European Commission DG Trade)
items.scope: industrial goods incl. steel, aluminium, polymers
items.notes: AD source: https://gmk.center/en/news/turkey-has-introduced-anti-dumping-hrs-duties-from-four-countries/ (citing the Official Gazette via Reuters). Direction of trade: Turkey is a net EXPORTER of flat steel to the EU and its domestic HRC (625 USD EXW) sits below the EU anchor; EU flows into Turkey are small. Turkish exports to the EU face the EU's 2026 steel TRQ regime (Q4 quotas exhausted 1 Oct; ~450 kt waiting at EU ports for 1 Jan, SMM 30 Oct). Turkey also applies the EU common external tariff to third countries (customs union). Conclusion: Turkish manufacturers buy steel at the DOMESTIC price (below the EU anchor), polymers at Middle-East/Russia CIF import prices.

items.basis: EU-Serbia Stabilisation and Association Agreement (signed 2008, in force 2013; OJ L 278, 18.10.2013) — industrial goods of EU origin enter Serbia duty-free (the DG Trade page confirms the SAA and the pan-Euro-Med origin rules applicable between the EU and Serbia from 6 Dec 2021). BUT Serbia imposed temporary steel import QUOTAS 1 Jan-30 Jun 2026: hot-rolled and cold-rolled products, rebar, wire rod and ribbed bar (with cement), steel quota >169,650 t over two quarters, allocated by country on 5-year import shares (EU countries, Turkey, BiH, Albania the largest); imports beyond quota pay an additional 50% customs duty.

items.basis: EU-Egypt Association Agreement (in force 2004) 'creates a free-trade area between the EU and Egypt by removing tariffs on industrial products'. BUT a definitive SAFEGUARD on steel imports runs 3 years from 1 Apr 2026 (Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade decree under Law No. 161 of 1998): first-year duties hot-rolled 13.6% (min $76/t), cold-rolled 13.7% (min $83/t), galvanised 14% (min $93/t), colour-coated 14.5% (min $122/t), billet 13.12% (min $70/t), stepping down each year. Safeguards are applied to all origins (WTO) — EU origin is not stated as exempt.

items.basis: EU-SADC Economic Partnership Agreement (signed June 2016 with Botswana, Lesotho, Mozambique, Namibia, Eswatini; applied since 2016) governs EU-South Africa goods trade and continues the 2000 TDCA liberalisation. 2026 measures: (1) SACU safeguard on corrosion-resistant (coated) steel coil from 12 Jun 2026 — 52.34% year 1, 37.34% year 2, 22.34% year 3 — on all countries except developing countries below 3% / 9% of imports, so EU-origin coated coil PAYS it; (2) South Africa raised MFN import tariffs on flat steel, non-alloy steel, bars, wire rod, pipes and tubes to 10-30% (from 0-15%) in May 2026, 'while certain preferential trade arrangements ... will remain in place'; (3) definitive AD on flat-rolled (HR coil/plate, P&O, uncoated, ≥600 mm) from China 6.99-47.92%, Japan 44.95-57.23%, Taiwan 24.20% (ITAC, Mar 2026) — not EU.
items.kind: official trade-agreement summary (European Commission DG Trade); ITAC decisions as reported (SteelOrbis, SMM)
items.scope: industrial goods; measures = steel
items.notes: Sources: safeguard https://www.steelorbis.com/steel-news/latest-news/s-africa-recommends-three-year-safeguard-duties-on-corrosion-resistant-steel-imports-1459525.htm (18 Jun 2026); tariff increase https://news.metal.com/en/newscontent/103914987-SMM-Steel-South-Africa-Raises-Steel-Import-Tariffs-to-Protect-Domestic-Industry (21 May 2026, via yieh.com); AD https://news.metal.com/en/newscontent/103824702-SMM-SteelSouth-Africa-issues-final-AD-ruling-on-flat-rolled-steel-from-3-Asian-nations (25 Mar 2026). Whether EU-origin HRC/CRC keeps a 0% EPA rate after the May 2026 increase was NOT confirmed against the SARS tariff book — verify. ITAC also opened a safeguard investigation on cold-rolled flat steel into SACU (SMM headline, not opened). Conclusion: South African buyers pay AMSA's domestic (import-parity-linked) price; EU coil is not a duty-free alternative for coated product.

notes: Question answered: do TR / RS / MA / TN / EG / ZA manufacturers buy at the European anchor? TR — NO: domestic mill price, BELOW the anchor (HRC 625 USD ≈ EUR 562/t EXW v EUR 745/t NW Europe, 30 Oct 2026); EU goods would enter duty-free but Turkey is a net exporter. RS — YES (assumed): EU duty-free under the SAA, no Serbian price published; H1 2026 import quotas with 50% out-of-quota duty. MA — NO for HRC: EU coil pays a 19% safeguard from 19 Jun 2026; other industrial goods duty-free. TN — YES: all industrial trade with the EU tariff-free, no steel measure found. EG — domestic Ezz price; EU flat steel pays a 13.6-14.5% safeguard (min $76-122/t) from 1 Apr 2026. ZA — domestic AMSA price; EU coated coil pays a 52.34% safeguard from 12 Jun 2026.

Not found (paywalled or unpublished): bar_1045, ss304_cr, al_premium, al_billet_premium, al_secondary for all six; polymers for RS, MA, TN, EG, ZA; HDPE / LDPE / ABS / PC / PA6 for TR. Fastmarkets runs 'Aluminium P1020A premium, cif dup Turkey' (MB-AL-0337) and '6063 extrusion billet premium, cif Turkey (Marmara)' (MB-AL-0296) — subscriber-only; its Turkey PFA Si7 premium was discontinued.
